name: Baalmon (X Antibody)
main_effect:
[When Digivolving] Return 1 [X Antibody] from your trash to your hand.
[When Digivolving] Trash the top 3 cards of your deck. If this Digimon has [Baalmon] or [X Antibody] in its digivolution cards, delete 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon instead.
source_effect: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has the [Wizard] or [Demon Lord] trait it gets +2000 DP.
